title: Enrollment Status Page mixes application types known to fail together

report.title: {Items.Count} Enrollment Status Page {Plural(Items.Count, 'profile blocks', 'profiles block')} on a risky mix of application types

messages.businessImpact: Certain combinations of application type are known to stall provisioning, which presents as a device stuck at the status page with no clear cause.
remediation: Reduce the blocking set to one application type where possible.
Move the remaining applications out of the blocking list and install them after sign-in.
messages.cannotSee: The combinations flagged come from the pack's reference data and reflect current guidance, which changes.
